## What Gumroad does

Platform for creators to sell digital products, courses, and memberships directly to customers.

- Gumroad is one of 23 APIs in the Payments for agents category on AgentGid.
- It is not among the 6 that can be started for free.
- 8 of them ship an official MCP server; Gumroad does not.

## Gumroad popularity

No public usage numbers for Gumroad yet: it has no official SDK on npm or PyPI that we track.

SDK downloads from npm and PyPI, weekly. Numbers as of Nov 17, 2026.

## Pricing

Free tier

None

10% + $0.50 per transaction (direct sales), 30% per transaction (Discover marketplace)

As reported on the official pricing page, checked Oct 10, 2026. Prices change: confirm before you buy. [gumroad.com/pricing](https://gumroad.com/pricing)
